item.title: Dragon Ball Sparking Zero DLC
item.description: I bought the Ultimate Edition for over 100-something euros when it was released. I reinstalled the game thinking it was free DLC. I launched the game, and the new modes and characters were locked. When I select a new mode, it takes me to the PSN Store page to pay 35 euros/dollars.... Go fuck yourselves, you shitty scammers! Shame on you!
